title: Kamishiro Rui — Unexpected Happenings〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: On a certain holiday
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now that we've concluded our Halloween show with great success, it's time to start thinking about the direction for the next show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Though, that's actually more or less settled.
I guess the main issue is the wire-flying part...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We've been using it as a way to jump on the stage so far, but it may be interesting to add in some of those flying parts often seen at male idol shows.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It won't be free-form flying, but we can at least make it look like the character is flying out from the stage.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (What I'm concerned about is how that will appear to the audience seated in different positions. I'll need to coordinate it with the lighting as well.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Of course, there's also the matter of safety.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The more wires we use or the more people on the fly system, the higher the risk of entanglement and accidents.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But it creates a greater impact when multiple people do it. A scene like that would be unforgettable.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (For future applications, we should probably design the system to be able to accommodate multiple people.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm going to need to do more tests and verifications. Which means my next step will be...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui... We're here.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, right. Robo-Nene's due for maintenance today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I was so engrossed in thinking about the next stage production that I'd forgotten about it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No problem. It wouldn't be the first time you've ever forgotten to eat or sleep because of that, anyway.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, you're absolutely right.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well then, let me get started on the maintenance now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, thanks. Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui, are these drawings on the table about the fly system we were talking about the other day?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We'll be incorporating that into the next show?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, I haven't decided yet.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've yet to come up with firm plans that will ensure a good balance of visual presentation, lighting, and safety.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Safety...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Are you still feeling bad about what happened? That Tsukasa got injured.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It would be a lie for me to say that it doesn't bother me anymore, but this is somewhat different.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How is it different?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What you're worried about is whether I'm being overly affected by it, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, yes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Then you can rest assured.
After all, thanks to you and Emu, I managed to talk things out with Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's just that, as a director, I should never take the actors on stage for granted.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Especially for someone like Tsukasa, who's willing to go along with anything I ask him to do.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see. So am I right to say you're just thinking ahead?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course you are.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm glad you're feeling yourself again, then.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright. That's all for Robo-Nene's maintenance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks. Well, I should head home now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, just a minute, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: When I had that fight with Tsukasa, your suggestion to visit SEKAI really helped.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I definitely wouldn't have been able to resolve that problem on my own. So I appreciated that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, KAITO was the one who gave you the advice you needed, though.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Heheh. Still, if you hadn't made the suggestion, I would still be stuck in a rut of worries by myself right now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's why I just wanted to say how grateful I am again.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to see how you'll direct the next show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I promised Tsukasa and Emu too, after all. You can expect to see great things indeed.
